items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: He finally went with Lawrence Welk.

ctx.x: Jubilee. I was going to ask about those trips that you made out there too.

Well, I brought Al Hoyt and I brought little Warren Luling and Pete Fountain. And I engineered that job because they never had Hoyt any other boys that I brought out there. And I told Pete at that time, I said, Pete, you're playing a lot of clarinet and maybe if the right people would hear you, maybe you'd get a break. And it's exactly what happened. Lawrence Welk's boy happened to be in the audience. He told his daddy he heard a terrific clarinet player. We gave Pete his tunes, Tin Roof Blues and the March of…
What was the first year you went out there?
